summary: Iter 159 (EmptyState rollout to Comms/Tasks/Settings/SponsorPortal/Financial + Tauri RemoteAccessManager scaffold) — backend + frontend regression. Backend: re-ran iter157 branding (4/4) + smoke recent modules (16/16) = 20/20 PASS, no 5xx anywhere. Frontend: verified critical Tauri-gating — `data-testid='remote-access-card'` is NOT in the DOM on /admin when accessed via the cloud preview (correct, since window.__TAURI__ is absent). All 6 pre-existing admin cards still render intact (Module Access, Security Checkpoints, Kiosk Links & Setup, Backup & Restore, Integrations & Email, Branding & Navigation). EmptyState testID wiring verified in source for all 7 new placements (comms-announcements-empty, comms-messages-empty, comms-conversations-empty, comms-thread-empty, tasks-boards-empty + tasks-empty-create-board-btn, settings-venues-empty + settings-empty-add-venue-btn, sponsor-updates-empty, fin-transfers-empty). At runtime the EmptyStates did NOT render because the demo DB has data populated (venues, conversations, announcements, boards, transfers all seeded) — same situation as iter 158 for accounting/socialwork tabs; components are wired correctly. Zero page runtime errors and zero new console errors observed (only pre-existing benign source-map warnings from html5-qrcode lib + Chrome Push-API-in-incognito notices). SponsorPortalPage import path is clean (EmptyState imported from ../components/EmptyState).
critical_code_review_comments: RemoteAccessManager.jsx: `isTauri()` guard at line 65 (`if (!isTauri()) return null;`) is the correct gate, and the polling interval at line 54 is correctly placed AFTER the early-return effect-guard (line 52 also early-returns inside useEffect), so on the cloud no interval is registered and no Tauri invoke is ever attempted — verified no console noise. Good defensive pattern.

Consider also gating the `import { invoke }` of Tauri APIs behind a dynamic import to keep the production bundle slightly smaller — currently the file is fine because it only calls `window.__TAURI__?.core?.invoke` via optional chaining (no static import of @tauri-apps/api), so dead-code elimination already strips it on web builds. Acceptable as-is.

Empty-state testid hand-coding continues (carried over from iter 158 review): now ~14 hand-coded testids across CommsPage/TasksPage/SettingsPage/SponsorPortalPage/FinancialPage. Stronger argument now for a centralised <EmptyStateWithRequiredTestId/> wrapper or a lint rule that asserts EmptyState always receives a `testid` prop. Risk: if a future contributor omits the testid, the e2e harness silently loses coverage. Low priority but accumulating debt.

FinancialPage.jsx:621 uses a raw <tr><td colSpan={4}> for the transfers empty case rather than the shared <EmptyState/> component used elsewhere. This is a presentational inconsistency (table-row vs card layout). Acceptable for table contexts, but consider an EmptyStateRow variant of the component so messaging/icon styling stays consistent across the app.
Tauri scaffold at /app/desktop/ is correctly out-of-scope for the cloud build — no Webpack/CRA imports reference it, so the bundle is unaffected. No regression observed.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (verifiable cases — Tauri-gating correct, admin cards intact, EmptyState wiring confirmed via source + DOM absence-when-data-exists)
